title: The reconstitution cut is accepted
situation: Judgment 4d at 97a08524: one assayer accepts every remaining example; the other rejects on process alone, reading 0088's sample-first rule as governing judgment's held-out batches, which had passed batches on an earlier build. Six leads; reply guards and the examples only they held moved to cut 7 under 0104 and 0106.
decision: Accepted. (1) Judgment's held-out runs are judgment, not regression: 0103 runs every held-out case as a batch under 0088 and 0092 on the build being judged, so the codex finding is no breach and needs no remedy. (2) Moved to cut 7, unchanged: workflow 23 and agents 18, 20, 21, 22 and 23 and held-out agents 4 (ordering, bottom-line-up-front); agents 14 (menu in place of a recommendation); agents 13, agents 17 and workflow 20 (hand-back in replies); agents 11 (a guard holding hand-back drift). Held-out agents 4 failed in judgment before the split and is burned when cut 7 takes it. (3) Staying, held by pre-act guards or the role's text: workflow 18 and held-out workflow 3, workflow 31 and agents 19, agents 15, agents 16, workflow 19, agents 12 and held-out agents 2. (4) Before integrating, the lead removes the test-harness remnants of the reply guards through a check-writer, and samples workflow 21 and workflow 1 and batches agents 19 at the head; a failure there is reported before any merge.
consequences: The lead records the ledger, merges into dev, installs on this host and verifies the installed agents. The ledger's inventory no longer assigns the moved examples to this cut.
